author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Whether you are brand new to Gmail or have been using it for years, there is something new to learn in this thorough tutorial on using Gmail, Google’s free email app!

You'll discover the basics, including navigating the interface, using the Quick Access bar, moving messages, handling attachments and photos, deleting and archiving emails, and searching your inbox.
Additionally, you'll learn effective ways to manage your inbox so you can keep up with your emails, including using labels, stars, moving or snoozing messages, setting up vacation auto-responders, and bulk deleting unwanted mail.

By the end of the video, you’ll not only know how to use Gmail to read and compose mail, but also how to become a master of organization in whatever way works the best for YOU!
